claims.statement: Alphabet discloses that its capital investments in property and equipment consist primarily of two major categories: (1) technical infrastructure, which consists of investments in servers and network equipment, data center land, and building construction and improvements; and (2) office facilities, ground-up development projects, and building improvements.
claims.period_context: Alphabet FY2025 10-K, Capital Expenditures and Leases / Capital Expenditures disclosure, page 38; the category disclosure is not tied to a single fiscal year in the read block.

citations.quote: Our capital investments in property and equipment consist primarily of the following major categories:
citations.label: Capital expenditures categories introduction

citations.quote: •technical infrastructure, which consists of our investments in servers and network equipment, data center land, and building construction and improvements; and
citations.label: Capital expenditures category 1

citations.quote: •office facilities, ground-up development projects, and building improvements.
citations.label: Capital expenditures category 2

claims.statement: For the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2025, Alphabet reported capital expenditures of $52.5 billion and $91.4 billion, respectively.
claims.period_context: Years ended December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2025, Alphabet FY2025 10-K, page 38.

citations.quote: During the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2025, we spent $52.5 billion and $91.4 billion on capital expenditures, respectively.
citations.label: Reported capital expenditures amounts

claims.statement: Alphabet discloses that in 2026 it expects to significantly increase, relative to 2025, its investment in technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers.
claims.period_context: Forward-looking statement for 2026 relative to 2025, Alphabet FY2025 10-K, page 38.

citations.quote: In 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers.
citations.label: Forward-looking capital expenditure expectation
